subject.add_team_member: You Are Now A Team Member

body.verify_email:
Dear {{name}},

Thank you for registering with {{project_title}}! To complete your registration, please verify your email address by entering the following One-Time Password (OTP):

{{verification_code}}

This OTP is valid for 10 minutes, so we recommend verifying your account right away to start exploring {{project_title}}.

If you did not attempt to register for a {{project_title}} account, please ignore this email.

For any assistance, feel free to reach out to us at {{support_email}}.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.registeration_completed:
Dear {{first_name}} {{last_name}},

Congratulations! Your email has been successfully verified, and your account with {{project_title}} is now active.

We're excited to have you on board and can’t wait for you to explore all that {{project_title}} has to offer.

If you have any questions or need help along the way, our support team is just a click away. Feel free to reach us at {{support_email}}.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.forgot_password:
Dear {{name}}

We received a request to reset your password. To reset your password, please enter this OTP: {{verification_code}}.

Please note that the OTP will expire after 10 minutes.

If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

For any assistance, please contact us at {{support_email}}

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.reset_password_success:
Dear {{name}}

We are writing to let you know that the password reset has been completed successfully.

You can now login to your account using your new password.

If you did not request a password reset, please contact our support team at {{support_email}} as soon as possible for assistance.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.change_password_success:
Dear {{name}}

This is to confirm that your {{project_title}} account password has been changed successfully.

If you did not initiate this change, please contact our support team at {{support_email}} immediately for assistance.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.add_team_member:
Dear {{name}},

You’ve been added as a team member on {{project_title}}, and an account has been created for you. Please use the credentials below to login:

Email Address: {{email}}
Password: {{password}}

To get started, click the link below to login:

{{link}}

Once logged in, you can change your password to one of your choice.

If you need any assistance or have questions, our support team is here to help. Feel free to reach out at {{support_email}}

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.suspend_user:
Dear {{first_name}} {{last_name}},

We regret to inform you that your account has been suspended.

This suspension is effective immediately, and you will no longer have access to the platform.

If you have questions, our support team is here to help. Feel free to reach out at {{support_email}}.

Thank you for understanding.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
body.activate_user:
Dear {{first_name}} {{last_name}},

We are pleased to inform you that your account has been reactivated.

You now have access to the platform.

If you have questions, our support team is here to help. Feel free to reach out at {{support_email}}.

With regards,
The {{project_title}} Team
